burst_control.claim: equivalence over these tests and observations
burst_control.scope: one compact diagnostic receiver burst; not the full corpus or shipping artifact

original_failures_preserved.finding: The initial qualifier expected a rich 32-call receiver to pass despite exceeding the shared 262144-byte case budget. It is now a required refusal beside a separate compact positive.
A compact 32-call burst lost 23 completed trace roots from the default queue of eight roots. Missing roots remained an incomplete result.
All 32 roots completed butone export failed. Later retained HTTP evidence identified the local limit of 32 requests; this was not proof of outbound queue saturation.
All 32 roots completed but the collector rejected the 33rd request after 32 trace bodies. The scoped collector budget now allows 64 requests without changing its 32 MiB byte limit.

All 149 applications completed; the final source-identity refusal correctly returned 4 while the controller expected 2. The original failed controller and expected 2/actual 4 receipt are unchanged. Explicit retained-only recovery requires that exact historical mismatch; default verification requires expected4/actual 4.

limits: Recorded macOS ARM64 and frozen LLVM22/provider only.
Declared existing source receivers/factories with fixed scalar construction; one selected synchronous method.
Source-field/private access helpers change the diagnostic build; this is not shipping artefact evidence.
All intermediate graphs are bounded; large valid schedules can exceed the shared case budget.
Queue/request headroom is for the recorded diagnostic corpus, not arbitrary metric rates or export latency.
Selected named serial trees are checked; invocation-scoped action attribution is not implemented.
No C++ release, object collection, live metric toggles, mutable object arguments, other method targets, resource or concurrent actions.
Aliases are local to each boundary; cross-boundary allocation identity and unobserved fields remain outside the claim.
Other providers, build graphs, compiler/sysroot/library closure and platforms require separate qualification.
